title: Interpolation of GEDI Biomass Estimates with Calibrated Uncertainty Quantification
abstract: arXiv:2601.16834v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Wall-to-wall biomass density estimation from NASA's GEDI mission requires interpolating sparse LIDAR observations across heterogeneous landscapes. While Random Forest and XGBoost are widely used, they predict each location independently from satellite features, without adapting to the varying difficulty of heterogeneous landscapes. We introduce Attentive Neural Processes (ANPs), a probabilistic meta-learning architecture that explicitly conditions predictions on local observation sets as well as geospatial foundation model embeddings. ANPs learn a flexible spatial covariance approximator that is more uncertain in complex landscapes and less in homogeneous areas. We validate this approach across five distinct biomes ranging from tropical Amazonian forests to boreal, temperate, and alpine ecosystems, demonstrating that ANPs achieve competitive accuracy while maintaining uncertainty calibration. translated_title: 基于校准不确定性量化的GEDI生物量估计插值方法
translated_abstract: NASA GEDI任务的全域生物量密度估计需要在异质性景观中对稀疏的激光雷达（LIDAR）观测进行插值。虽然随机森林和XGBoost被广泛使用，但它们仅基于卫星特征对每个位置进行独立预测，无法适应异质性景观中不同的预测难度。我们引入了注意力神经过程，这是一种概率元学习架构，它显式地使预测同时依赖于局部观测集合和地理空间基础模型嵌入。ANP学习到一个灵活的空间协方差近似器，在复杂景观中表现出更高的不确定性，而在均质区域中表现出较低的不确定性。我们在从热带亚马逊森林到北方、温带和高山生态系统的五种不同生物群系中验证了该方法，结果表明ANP在保持不确定性校准的同时实现了具有竞争力的精度。我们展示了一个可扩展的、经验校准的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出注意力神经过程（ANP）概率元学习架构，通过结合局部激光雷达观测集合与地理空间基础模型嵌入来插值GEDI稀疏生物量观测，能够根据景观异质性自适应调整不确定性，并在五种生物群系中实现了竞争性精度和良好的不确定性校准。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Attentive Neural Processes (ANPs), a probabilistic meta-learning architecture that interpolates sparse GEDI biomass observations by conditioning on local LIDAR observation sets and geospatial foundation model embeddings, achieving competitive accuracy with well-calibrated uncertainty across five distinct biomes.
